'''Nemuu''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] and part of the [[Nkik clan]]. Nemuu was a spy who was gathering information on a [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|new Imperial assassin droid]] that was being built on Tatooine. He recorded holographic messages on [[Optical Information Crystal]]s for clan leader [[Wimateeka]], hoping to stop the construction of the droids. Those messages were eventually retrieved by a droid that had been built by a [[Unidentified Rebel agent (droid builder)|Rebel agent]].
